scope: Full-stack dogfood; use owned ooRexx/Alchemy components
architecture_rules: No Postfix, Dovecot, slapd, Nginx, commercial webmail, third-party MCP authority
Own IMAP/SMTP/LDAP servers must be used; verify inbound listeners instead of assuming from client library description
Wire renderer presentation only; ooRexx owns behavior; NotNotes authority remains original
CNAME is DNS indirection; HTTPS routes based on requested Host/SNI and explicit aliases
Gateway Wire portal LDAP-gated; backend 3270 and web target auth remains independently enforced
No invented endpoint addresses, backend ports, target capabilities or successful tests
Signing key roles separately scoped; no private key in repo
Do not publish unapproved mcp.rasenfalcon.com DNS
No release is operational until real end-to-end protocol tests pass

tasks.title: Source/acceptance inventory of OUR components
tasks.deliverable: Locate accepted source, manifests and exact revision for ooRexx HTTPS Server, SMTP Secure Stack/server, IMAP server/client, LDAP Identity Directory, Wire UI Server/Builder, NotNotes, Crypto/PKI, MCP Service, Connect Selector, Deployment and 3270 or terminal modules. Produce capability matrix: implemented/tested/missing.
tasks.acceptance: Each dependency has package SHA, tested API, service entry point, owner and evidence; unverified interfaces labeled UNKNOWN rather than assumed.

tasks.title: RasenFalcon architecture and hard dependency contract
tasks.deliverable: Author one authority diagram and service/transport mapping. All mail, LDAP, web and MCP application semantics implemented with owned ooRexx/Alchemy modules. Systemd/OpenSSL/standard network protocols are platform support, not product substitutes.
tasks.acceptance: No Postfix, Dovecot, slapd, Nginx, third-party webmail, third-party MCP server or duplicated Wire/NotNotes authority in dependency closure.

tasks.title: Physical host and service placement
tasks.deliverable: Confirm actual OS, architecture, listener conflicts, resources and role placement for gateway, office, NOC, london1 and MCP; map 213.255.246.44 only to london1; no assumption gateway/office resolve to same IP.
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated server facts, listening ports, existing services and approved separation/backups recorded before mutations.

tasks.title: DNS and hostname authority
tasks.deliverable: Configure or document authoritative DNS: noc CNAME london1; london1 A 213.255.246.44; gateway mail/HTTPS; office Wire apps; MCP DNS user-managed; MX points at gateway; public apex/www. Track TTL and PTR separately.
tasks.acceptance: Independent DNS checks prove requested records. Deployment never rewrites user-managed mcp DNS; no invented IP for gateway/office.

tasks.title: Build and pinned-component release pipeline
tasks.deliverable: Create source builds, immutable signed/hash-pinned release manifest, dependency closure, build logs, unit tests and reproducible qualification on target OS.
tasks.acceptance: Clean build only uses pinned owned components; missing package or failing module test blocks release.

tasks.title: Installer and systemd lifecycle controller
tasks.deliverable: Implement preflight/install/apply/activate/verify/status/rollback service deployment using owned component archives. Generate units and environment files from accepted service entry points, not placeholders.
tasks.acceptance: Idempotence, reboot autorestart, explicit human activation approval and rollback; no green status without protocol end-to-end acceptance.

tasks.title: Service contract/health-test harness
tasks.deliverable: Implement machine-verifiable contract tests, fixture accounts, signed acceptance evidence, timeouts, and negative tests for mail, Wire, LDAP, MCP, terminal and browser proxy.
tasks.acceptance: Every release includes non-stub tests for all mandatory capabilities, with explicit failure propagation and no synthetic PASS.

tasks.title: HTTPS virtual hosts, aliases and SNI
tasks.deliverable: Enhance existing ooRexx HTTPS Server with multi-host TLS certificate selection, normalized Host/:authority handling, virtual-host map, explicit aliases, and fail-closed unknown/mismatched authority. DNS CNAME not resolved per request.
tasks.acceptance: http request to noc.rasenfalcon.com (CNAME london1) retains noc host, has valid cert and correct vhost. SNI/Host mismatch and unknown host refused with proper HTTP response such as 421.

tasks.title: Native TLS certificate provisioning and renewal
tasks.deliverable: Integrate ACME/certificate renewal (or accepted owned implementation) into HTTPS lifecycle; distinct identities for gateway, office, noc and mcp. TLS remains in native HTTPS server, no proxy substitution.
tasks.acceptance: Hostname validation, renewal staging, rotation without dropping sessions where supported, expired/untrusted-key negative tests.

tasks.title: HTTPS request routing and application isolation
tasks.deliverable: Host routing: public site on apex/www; gateway Wire portal; office /mail and /notes; mcp only separately governed routes; NOC host explicit. Prevent Host injection/open reverse proxy and cross-vhost auth/session leakage.
tasks.acceptance: Correct vhost and independent cookies/headers for each hostname and route; wrong vhost cannot access private handler.

tasks.title: LDAP server deployment, identity schema and availability
tasks.deliverable: Deploy the accepted ooRexx LDAP Identity Directory authoritative service, accounts/groups/mail addresses, LDAPS or StartTLS, local/replica topology and recovery according to accepted contracts.
tasks.acceptance: Own LDAP server binds, search, password/revoke, group tests and restart; no slapd installed; failure denies authentication.

tasks.title: LDAP authenticator and per-service permissions
tasks.deliverable: Implement reusable LDAP-backed authentication/session boundary for gateway Wire, office Wire, mail submission/IMAP and MCP bearer/OAuth mapping; local role checks independent of renderer.
tasks.acceptance: Allowed/denied accounts, lockout/revocation, cookie CSRF protection, anti-fixation, session logout, group changes reflected across all consumers.

tasks.title: Owned cryptographic key issuance and signing lifecycle
tasks.deliverable: Pin ooRexx Crypto/PKI, implement key issuance and lifecycle for TLS, SMTP DKIM, person/service message signatures and signed NotNotes, with separate keys/ACLs, HSM/provider where available.
tasks.acceptance: Issue, verify, rotate, revoke and audit work. Private keys never enter source release/MCP output; no silent authority to sign on behalf of people.

tasks.title: Native mail gateway SMTP listener and spool
tasks.deliverable: Prove existing owned SMTP server implements inbound SMTP port 25, EHLO, STARTTLS policy, RCPT recipient validation, durable spool and local delivery hooks. Implement any missing listener/queue/DSN/retry adapters in ooRexx SMTP component.
tasks.acceptance: External unauthenticated mail to existing rasenfalcon recipient accepted and delivered; invalid RCPT and unauthorized relay rejected; crashes do not lose accepted mail.

tasks.title: Native SMTP authenticated submission
tasks.deliverable: Add/qualify port 587 submission AUTH with LDAP identity, TLS, MAIL FROM ownership, quotas, spool state and retry semantics in our SMTP service.
tasks.acceptance: Authorized per-user send works; mismatched sender, invalid bind and unauthenticated relay denied; delivery receipt/evidence recorded.

tasks.title: Native IMAP listener and mailbox semantics
tasks.deliverable: Prove our IMAP package actually contains the server-side TCP listener and RFC IMAP4rev1/2 subset required (not merely IMAP client/service adapter); implement missing server bridge. Mailbox UIDVALIDITY, UID and persistent flags are authoritative.
tasks.acceptance: External IMAPS 993 authenticated connect/list/select/fetch/store/move works; UID identity survives restart; no Dovecot replacement.

tasks.title: Native mailbox storage & SMTP-to-IMAP delivery
tasks.deliverable: Connect owned SMTP delivery to owned mailbox store through accepted Storage Fabric/NoSQL contracts; enforce quotas, retention, indexes, MIME streaming and UIDVALIDITY rules.
tasks.acceptance: Accepted SMTP transaction appears in intended IMAP mailbox and not in another; transactional durability, quotas and UID proof pass.

tasks.title: Native mail authentication, TLS and abuse controls
tasks.deliverable: Enforce LDAP-backed IMAP and SMTP identities, rate limits, abuse suppression, size limits, malformed MIME defenses, SPF/DKIM/DMARC integration points and delivery audit in our stack.
tasks.acceptance: Reject open relay, credential brute-force, forgery and oversized attack cases; no plaintext auth without protected transport.

tasks.title: Mail DNS and outbound authenticity
tasks.deliverable: Publish validated MX gateway, SPF, DKIM selectors, DMARC and PTR coordination for gateway; TLS cert valid for mail use; key rollover policy.
tasks.acceptance: Independent inbound/outbound test identifies authenticated domain and no false DNS/PTR claims; receiver verifies DKIM.

tasks.title: Separate ChatGPT and Claude mailbox principals
tasks.deliverable: Provision separately-scoped accounts (proposed chatgpt@ and claude@rasenfalcon.com) with isolated mailboxes, distinct credentials, rate limits and audit; client-side access only through scoped connectors.
tasks.acceptance: Each account reads/sends as itself only. Cross-principal read/send denied; disable/revoke severs access.

tasks.title: Mail MCP service implementation
tasks.deliverable: Build MCP tool adapter on OUR MCP service and IMAP/SMTP APIs: inbox/folders/search/get/draft/submit, attachments with limits, status and per-account OAuth/scopes; not a separate mailbox service.
tasks.acceptance: MCP read/send test passes with each own principal; denied scope cannot send or read another mailbox; messages treated as untrusted content.

tasks.title: ChatGPT/Claude MCP connector compatibility
tasks.deliverable: Validate real MCP transport/auth/tool description compatibility with currently supported ChatGPT and Claude connection flows; browser/user approval where required.
tasks.acceptance: Both clients can independently connect to own account and read/send a controlled challenge; unsupported connector features documented truthfully.

tasks.title: Wire MailReader semantic core and IMAP source window
tasks.deliverable: Promote MailReader fixture to real ooRexx mail application behaviour while reusing accepted Wire/Builder source/filtered windows and stable mailbox|UIDVALIDITY|UID key.
tasks.acceptance: 200k message fixture only projects bounded visible rows; actions and semantic traces identical headless and browser.

tasks.title: office Wire webmail application
tasks.deliverable: Build office.rasenfalcon.com/mail: authenticated folders, search, thread/detail, compose/reply/forward, attachments, draft, sent, accessibility/responsive; no browser-owned business truth.
tasks.acceptance: Browser receives test email, reads, replies, marks, searches and attaches; authorization checks are server-side and hostile HTML inert.

tasks.title: NotNotes semantic service and persistence contract
tasks.deliverable: Qualify our NotNotes document authority, Mini App, revisioning, links, permissions, intentions, persistence and time semantics; implement any missing web-safe service adapter.
tasks.acceptance: Create/read/edit/link/unlink/revision-conflict/ACL success and denial; no second document store.

tasks.title: office Wire NotNotes application
tasks.deliverable: Build office.rasenfalcon.com/notes Wire semantic UI: document explorer, edit, links, search, permissions, versions, intentions and accessibility.
tasks.acceptance: Same semantic trace through TestRenderer and Web; editing and concurrent revision conflicts behave correctly.

tasks.title: NotNotes MCP service
tasks.deliverable: Build on owned MCP service: list/search/read/create/update/link/unlink, intentions with per-doc ACL and optimistic concurrency preconditions.
tasks.acceptance: Denied doc access, stale revision and prompt injection cannot cause effects; auditable creation and edits succeed.

tasks.title: Mail + NotNotes signing operations
tasks.deliverable: Expose signing/verification in owned services; canonical signed content and person/service authority separation. Do not conflate DKIM with user document signing.
tasks.acceptance: Tamper, revoked key, bad signer and successful verification test matrix passes; user signature requires explicit proper authority.

tasks.title: Gateway authenticated Wire portal
tasks.deliverable: Build gateway.rasenfalcon.com as Wire ops portal listing only approved terminals and web destinations; LDAP login and group-based session grants before showing/connecting.
tasks.acceptance: Unauthenticated GET/actions deny; authenticated but unauthorized account cannot see or connect targets; logout terminates sessions.

tasks.title: Browser 3270 protocol/session adapter
tasks.deliverable: Implement or reuse an owned TN3270/TN3270E client/session library, 3270 data stream screen model, keyboard AID keys, protected fields, EBCDIC code pages, disconnect/reconnect; transport scoped, no raw browser sockets.
tasks.acceptance: Recorded fixtures and host-backed session tests prove 3270 data/keyboard fidelity; unsupported host mode is explicit error, not silent terminal emulation.

tasks.title: Wire 3270 screen renderer and browser interaction
tasks.deliverable: Implement Wire semantic terminal surface with screen coordinate/grid, cursor, protected-input state, PF/PA/Enter/Clear and accessibility for web browser.
tasks.acceptance: 3270 fixture golden traces and live session have correct screen render, key events and session teardown.

tasks.title: ed209zz TN3270 session binding
tasks.deliverable: Configure approved network and port for ed209zz, endpoint certificate/host authentication where supported, LDAP portal authorization and backend host sign-on distinct from portal auth.
tasks.acceptance: Authorized user can open real ed209zz session; denied users cannot; target errors and session reset handled.

tasks.title: ed209z TN3270 session binding
tasks.deliverable: Configure approved network and port for ed209z, same policy, separate host target identity and protected sign-on.
tasks.acceptance: Authorized session reaches ed209z with correct terminal identity; all negative cases pass.

tasks.title: Approved web access relay (non-open proxy)
tasks.deliverable: Build owned HTTPS/WebSocket tunnel/reverse access facade with fixed allowlisted targets, upstream origin/header/auth isolation, WebSocket support where needed, no arbitrary URL fetch or SSRF.
tasks.acceptance: Unauthenticated, unlisted and cross-origin destinations rejected; sessions are audited and browser content isolated.

tasks.title: ed209cray web access binding
tasks.deliverable: Map approved upstream URL/port and TLS trust for ed209cray through gateway authenticated Wire entry, without exposing raw target to unauthenticated internet.
tasks.acceptance: Authorized user reaches expected web UI and gets correct target; blocked group and unknown URLs denied.

tasks.title: ed209tops web access binding
tasks.deliverable: Map approved upstream URL/port and TLS trust for ed209tops through gateway authenticated Wire entry.
tasks.acceptance: Authorized user reaches expected web UI; isolation, audit, logout and denied group verified.

tasks.title: NOC HTTPS alias and operations access
tasks.deliverable: Configure noc.rasenfalcon.com CNAME london1 and decide NOC app/path mapping only from existing approved NOC design; ensure correct TLS SNI and HTTP host routing, independent of any speculative target.
tasks.acceptance: Alias and canonical addresses resolve, valid cert for requested noc hostname, correct route and denied unknown/mismatched host.

tasks.title: Public rasenfalcon.com website
tasks.deliverable: Build minimal owned HTTPS-hosted public website, branding/content approval, legal/contact route, accessibility; no external CMS or user tracking by default.
tasks.acceptance: Public site works via TLS with approved content; private service paths not accessible from apex virtual host.

tasks.title: Hosted service startup units and dependency readiness
tasks.deliverable: Codex creates executable exact service entry points, systemd units, ordering, secrets files, restarts, readiness checks and operational permissions for accepted owned components.
tasks.acceptance: After reboot each service is active only when its real protocol endpoint is ready; no placeholder binary, fake healthz or blind start.

tasks.title: Full-stack secure configuration and firewall plan
tasks.deliverable: Define public 443,25,587,993 as applicable; keep LDAP/private RPC and internal 3270 access restricted; disallow unsolicited lateral access; SNI ACL, CSP, CSRF, MFA plan and audits.
tasks.acceptance: Port and route matrix is enforced; unauthenticated portal access, arbitrary proxying and LDAP exposure tests fail closed.

tasks.title: Instrumentation and cross-service trace evidence
tasks.deliverable: Use owned Instrumentation Mesh/Log components for lifecycle, mail, session, HTTP routing, key and MCP audit with opaque correlators and no secret/message body leakage.
tasks.acceptance: Fault-injected cases observable with bounded logs; cross-system event lineage preserved and private content not emitted.

tasks.title: Backup and disaster recovery of owned stores
tasks.deliverable: Own Storage Fabric snapshots for mailbox, NotNotes, LDAP and signing metadata/keys as appropriate; encrypt and perform restore exercise with identity and UID semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Restore reconstructs accepted messages/documents/accounts and revocation state; measured RPO/RTO, key isolation, audit.

tasks.title: Mail/Office/MCP complete end-to-end trial
tasks.deliverable: Test inbound internet SMTP → our store → our IMAP → office Wire read → reply via own SMTP → agent MCP read/send → NotNotes MCP edit/sign.
tasks.acceptance: Controlled live fixtures, expected message IDs and authenticated actors; every hop traced and negative cases proved.

tasks.title: Gateway operations real end-to-end trial
tasks.deliverable: LDAP portal login → Wire target selection → real 3270 ed209zz/z → real web ed209cray/ed209tops; 403/deny, invalid session, logout and target outage tests.
tasks.acceptance: All four targets accessible only to authorized accounts and reliable disconnect/restart. No success based solely on mock fixtures.

tasks.title: Independent reboot/upgrade/rollback qualification
tasks.deliverable: Reboot actual host, confirm auto-start/dependencies, negative tests and E2E operations; exercise failed release apply, rollback and restoration.
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent tests still pass after reboot and rollback, without permissions widening or data loss.

tasks.title: Publication, commissioning and sign-off
tasks.deliverable: Package results, exact source/version hashes, DNS/TLS/cert records, server configuration, ACLs, runbooks, on-call and human acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: One explicit ACCEPT/REJECT decision and live evidence. Never claim operational before user-approved cutover.
